thread:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Synthetic network probes failing for us-east-1 (probe-group/net-cc-us-east). 30+ probe failures across DNS resolution and cross-region traceroutes since 2026-02-18T18:14Z. Paging on-call SRE rotation. Alert: https://alerts.redwood.ops/alert/ALRT-9203

Ashok: Acknowledging. I'm on it. First question — do we have any customer-facing errors reported?

María: No incoming error spikes in the API LB metrics or 5xx counts. Datadog RUM shows normal latencies for production apps in us-east-1. However, I see a telemetry gap for the synthetic probe agent between 18:12–18:20 UTC (no heartbeats).

Jamal: NetworkOps here. We observed intermittent BGP updates in us-east-1a around the same window; looks like a control-plane flapping event that lasted ~4min. Will check DNS resolver logs — could be related.

Ashok: Running a quick health check from a prod node to internal control plane endpoints.

```
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://internal-api.us-east-1.redwood.local/healthz
200
```
Response from a couple of prod instances is 200. No customer-facing failures so far.

María: Confirming — no error budgets impacted. I suspect this is a monitoring probe/agent problem (agent lost connectivity to central telemetry) rather than a real outage. But the pager threshold triggered because probe failure count jumped.

oncall-bot: Created incident INC-20260218-03 in Opsgenie (https://opsgenie.redwood/incidents/INC-20260218-03). Escalated to @NetworkOps.

SRE Rotation: Good catch. If this is agent/monitoring-only, we should avoid noisy pages. For this incident: (1) verify customer traffic is unaffected, (2) disable synthetic probes for the group to stop further paging, (3) collect agent logs and traceroutes, (4) handoff to NetworkOps if routing/DNS confirmed.

Ashok: Disabling the failing probe group now to suppress pages.

```
# monitoring-cli disable-probe --group net-cc-us-east --by oncall
Response: probe-group net-cc-us-east disabled (reason: noisy failures during control-plane instability)
```
:white_check_mark: Disabled at 18:23 UTC.

María: Pulled the agent logs from the monitoring node. See repeated errors resolving the central telemetry endpoint: 

```
[18:12:05] lookup telemetry.redwood.local: temporary failure in name resolution
[18:12:07] lookup telemetry.redwood.local: connection timed out
[18:16:12] agent heartbeat resumed
```
Looks like the probe agent lost DNS resolution during the BGP flap window.

Jamal (NetworkOps): We reverted an automated resolver config change that rolled out at 18:10 UTC and was causing asymmetric routing for the monitoring fleet. Revert applied at 18:22 UTC. Resolver logs show normal responses after 18:21:30.

NetworkOps: Traceroute samples from monitoring hosts before revert show consistently failing hops into us-east-1a. After revert they succeed. Example:

```
traceroute to telemetry.redwood.local (10.240.12.8), 30 hops max
 1  10.0.0.1  0.5 ms
 2  10.1.2.1  0.9 ms
 3  * * *    (packet dropped)
 4  10.2.3.1  1.2 ms
```
Post-revert: no packet drops.

Ashok: Telemetry resumed; synthetic failing rate dropped to 0% by 18:25 UTC. Turning probe group back to monitoring-only (no pages).

```
monitoring-cli enable-probe --group net-cc-us-east --mode monitoring-only
Response: probe-group net-cc-us-east set to monitoring-only
```

María: Confirmed — Datadog shows agent heartbeats resumed and no client-side errors.

SRE Rotation: Summary / customer impact: NO customer-facing impact identified. Root cause: resolver config rollout caused asymmetric routing affecting monitoring probes, producing a false-positive alert. Immediate mitigation: revert resolver rollout and disable noisy probes.

SRE Rotation: Action items (assigned):
- NetworkOps/Jamal: add canary gate to resolver rollouts to prevent asymmetric pathing (ETA 1 week).
- Observability/María: patch alert rule to require corroboration from production traffic metrics before paging (ETA 3 days).
- SRE/Ashok: add probe health-heartbeat threshold to suppress pages when probe agent heartbeat missing (ETA 48h).
- Docs: update runbook to include "verify prod traffic" step before paging for regional probe alerts.

Ashok: I'll do the handoff to the next rotation. Leaving notes in INC-20260218-03 and will follow up on the postmortem.

María: Thanks everyone. Closing the active paging loop now. :white_check_mark:
